title: Panigale V4 R Homologation (Touring Pack)
description: The Ducati Panigale V4 R Homologation (Touring Pack) is engineered for blistering apex speeds and track dominance, positioned in the Homologation Superbike segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 108 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. The cockpit is configured with an Aggressive Forward Tuck riding stance and a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
